title: Credit Terms sits under Payment Methods in Settings and opens on Active
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure all twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • Start on the Settings page.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Settings menu, find the Finance group.
  2. Click "Credit Terms".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Finance group shows "Credit Terms" directly below "Payment Methods".

Step 2:

  • The Credit Terms page opens.
  • Its header reads "Credit Terms", with a primary "New Credit Term" button at the top right and a "⋯" menu beside it.
  • Below the header are two tabs, "Active" and "Inactive", each followed by the number of terms in it, and the Active tab is selected.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S1-R1: “Under Settings, in the Finance group, a "Credit Terms" item appears directly below "Payment Methods". Selecting it opens the Credit Terms page.”
  • S1-R2: “The page header shows the title "Credit Terms" and, top right, a primary "New Credit Term" button (Story 3: Create or edit a credit term) with a "⋯" page menu beside it (Story 12: Credit Terms audit log).”
  • S1-R3: “Below the header are two tabs, "Active" and "Inactive", each followed by a count of the terms in it. The page opens on Active.”
  • S11-R4: “The Credit Terms page appears under Settings → Finance for every user with 'Settings → Finance'.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “Viewing and using the Credit Terms page (the list, New Credit Term, Edit, Make Default, Deactivate, Reactivate, Delete) is governed by 'Settings → Finance', the same permission as Payment Methods.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
